step.cmd: Fact-find with the client or employer. Refer to Digest 4.3.5 — Lay days or periods of leave .
Determine if the client or employer was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client or employer was contacted, go to step 6.
If the client or employer was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 or Z-00-00-00 letter, go to Failure to provide information . Failure to provide information

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Lay days — [employer’s name] — [client or employer].”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
